method: Read the model rows from seven paginated gateway UI pages and deduplicate identical displayed row text. This is an account-wide time window, not a request-ID match. Pagination can shift and identical legitimate rows can collapse.
limits: Concurrent account activity may be included.
Unshown or failed attempts may be missing.
No per-arm attribution or total study invoice can be established from this window.
aggregateInputCrossCheck: 383 distinct assistant message IDs and their combined uncached, cache-read and cache-creation input sums equal the model/time-window deduplicated UI row-text count and input sums. This is not a per-request or per-arm match.
